Abstract text read in full in the Crossref record (URL given) and again in OpenAlex; it ends 'Clinical trial information: NCT06664983'. 84 patients randomised 1:1 at three hospitals to TPC + cadonilimab or TPC; median follow-up 10.2 months; median PFS 8.9 vs 5.1 months, HR 0.47 (95% CI 0.28-0.80), P=0.004; ORR 61.9% vs 52.4% (P=0.378); median OS not reached. Recorded as met on PFS, the single primary endpoint. The abstract does not say whether PFS was by independent review (the registry specifies independent review). DATE: 2026-05-27 is the date the DOI record was created in Crossref (also the OpenAlex publication date); the supplement issue is dated 2026-06-01. ascopubs.org returned 403 and the ASCO meeting site would not render, so the abstract could not be read there. A third-party listing of the ASCO schedule (melanoma.org.au, opened) says regular abstracts were released on 2026-05-21, so the true first public date is probably six days earlier than recorded (lag 212 rather than 218 days). Nothing earlier found: Crossref titles with cadonilimab + nasopharyngeal since 2024 are this abstract, the single-arm phase 2 of the same combination (ESMO 2024 893P; BMC Med 2025-03-11) and COMPASSION-06; PubMed by number 0; ClinicalTrials.gov API record fetched 2026-10-09 still shows active not recruiting, last update 2024-10-30, no results.
